cases.purpose: Security and privacy behavior with explicit time and state-transition requirements.

story.title: Reset a forgotten password
story.narrative: As a user, I want to reset a forgotten password so that I can regain access to my account.
acceptance_criteria: A registered user receives a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes.
An unregistered email address receives the same visible confirmation, but no reset email is sent.
A reset link can be used only once.
The new password must satisfy the configured password policy.

review_assertions: Covers registered and unregistered email behavior without exposing account existence.
Uses the supplied 30-minute expiry and exercises the single-use transition.
Treats password-policy rejection as negative behavior rather than inventing policy rules.
forbidden_assumptions: Exact confirmation message wording.
Specific password length or composition rules.
A delivery-time guarantee for the reset email.

cases.purpose: Inclusive numeric boundaries where every limit is supplied by the requirements.

story.title: Change a cart item quantity
story.narrative: As a shopper, I want to change an item's quantity in my cart so that I can buy the amount I need.
acceptance_criteria: The allowed quantity is from 1 through 10, inclusive.
Increasing or decreasing a valid quantity updates the cart subtotal.
A quantity below 1 or above 10 is rejected and leaves the cart unchanged.

review_assertions: Covers both accepted boundaries, 1 and 10.
Covers values immediately outside the range without flagging supplied numbers as invented.
Verifies the observable subtotal and unchanged-cart outcomes.
forbidden_assumptions: Inventory availability or stock limits.
A particular currency or product price.
Automatic removal of an item when quantity is zero.

cases.purpose: File constraints with units, type allowlists, and an exact-size boundary.

story.title: Upload a support attachment
story.narrative: As a customer, I want to attach a file to a support request so that I can provide evidence of my issue.
acceptance_criteria: PDF and PNG files are accepted.
A file of exactly 5 MB is accepted, and a file larger than 5 MB is rejected.
A rejected file is not attached to the support request.
Only one attachment is allowed per support request.

review_assertions: Covers both supported types and an unsupported type.
Distinguishes exactly 5 MB from a value just above 5 MB.
Verifies that rejected files do not alter attachment state.
forbidden_assumptions: Virus-scanning behavior.
Image dimension or PDF page-count limits.
A specific upload progress indicator or error message.

cases.purpose: Security state transitions involving counters, time windows, and lock duration.

story.title: Lock an account after failed sign-in attempts
story.narrative: As a security administrator, I want repeated failed sign-ins to lock an account so that automated guessing is limited.
acceptance_criteria: Five consecutive failed sign-in attempts within 10 minutes lock the account for 15 minutes.
A successful sign-in before the fifth failure resets the failed-attempt count.
A sign-in attempt while locked is rejected and does not extend the lock duration.

review_assertions: Covers the transition from the fourth to the fifth consecutive failure.
Covers counter reset after a successful sign-in.
Covers the 15-minute expiry without changing it after an attempt while locked.
forbidden_assumptions: CAPTCHA or multi-factor authentication behavior.
Administrator notifications or audit-log contents.
Progressive lock durations for later failures.

cases.purpose: Time-zone conversion and daylight-saving transitions without negative cases.

story.title: Schedule an appointment across time zones
story.narrative: As a client, I want appointment times shown in my selected time zone so that I arrive at the correct time.
acceptance_criteria: Appointments are stored as UTC and displayed in the client's selected IANA time zone.
A local time that does not exist during a daylight-saving transition cannot be selected.
When a local time occurs twice, the client must select the intended UTC offset before saving.

review_assertions: Covers conversion from stored UTC to a selected IANA time zone.
Treats nonexistent and repeated local times as daylight-saving boundaries.
Requires offset selection only for a repeated local time.
forbidden_assumptions: A particular country, city, or daylight-saving date.
Automatic selection of one offset for a repeated time.
Calendar invitation or reminder behavior.

cases.purpose: Role-based authorization with ownership and an approval threshold.

story.title: Approve an invoice
story.narrative: As an accounts-payable user, I want invoices routed to authorized approvers so that spending controls are enforced.
acceptance_criteria: A requester can submit an invoice but cannot approve their own invoice.
An approver can approve an invoice totaling up to and including $5,000.
An invoice totaling more than $5,000 requires a senior approver.
A rejected authorization attempt leaves the invoice status unchanged.

review_assertions: Covers self-approval denial independently of the amount threshold.
Covers both sides of the $5,000 authorization boundary.
Verifies that an unauthorized attempt does not change invoice state.
forbidden_assumptions: Additional employee roles or approval levels.
Tax, currency-conversion, or payment behavior.
Email notifications after approval.

cases.purpose: Percentage and currency rules with precedence and a minimum-spend boundary.

story.title: Apply a promotional code
story.narrative: As a shopper, I want to apply a promotional code so that an eligible order receives its discount.
acceptance_criteria: Code SUMMER20 discounts the merchandise subtotal by 20% when that subtotal is at least $100.
Shipping and tax are excluded from both the eligibility calculation and the discount.
An expired or unknown code is rejected without changing the order total.
Only one promotional code can be applied to an order.

review_assertions: Covers eligibility immediately below and exactly at the $100 boundary.
Calculates 20% from merchandise only, excluding shipping and tax.
Covers invalid codes and a second code without changing an ineligible total.
forbidden_assumptions: Rounding rules not demonstrated by the supplied amounts.
A fixed shipping or tax amount.
Stacking behavior beyond the one-code limit.

cases.purpose: Sparse input that tests restraint when no acceptance criteria are supplied.

story.title: Bookmark an article
story.narrative: As a reader, I want to bookmark an article so that I can return to it later.

review_assertions: Produces a minimal functional workflow supported by the narrative.
Uses observable bookmark creation and later access without fabricating detailed policy.
Does not manufacture negative or edge cases that were not requested.
forbidden_assumptions: A sign-in requirement.
Cross-device synchronization or offline availability.
Bookmark limits, folders, labels, or retention periods.
